description: This file is a shell script containing a test suite for Git's rename detection functionality. It sets up test cases, runs Git diff commands with various options, and compares the output against expected results to verify rename and copy detection behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided commands.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Adds or removes files from the Git index to prepare the test state.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Creates a tree object from the current index, used for comparisons.

methods.name: git diff-index
methods.description: Produces diff output between the index and the tree, with options for rename detection.
